text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: dedicated-resv-pool-42 autoscaler failing to scale. queue_growth=+138% over 15m, queued_requests=1243, scale_attempts=0, error=QuotaExceeded / 429 from cloud API. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/pools/resv-42/overview

oncall_maya: ack taking this. paging oncall. pinging @lia @samir for infra and autoscale context. tagging cs: @neha_cs

lia: looking at autoscaler logs now. seeing repeated 429s from cloud provider when requesting vGPU allocations. also hit a hard quota: vgpu_quota_remaining=0. stack snippet: `CloudAPIError(Status=429, RetryAfter=1s)` then `QuotaError(code=VGPU_QUOTA_EXCEEDED)`

samir: quick triage options: 1) throttle non-critical background batch routes for Greenstone Labs (reduce queue inflow). 2) spill latency-sensitive requests to hosted shared pool with rate-limiting. 3) manual bump of reserved pool (if quota can be increased via cloud console) or evict low-priority preemptible workloads to free GPUs. 4) short-term customer rate-limit for Greenstone if needed.

neha_cs: Greenstone reports batch ingest jobs delayed, some jobs failing with timeouts. CS dashboard shows 15-40m job latency increase; they're worried about nightly SLA. They're on standby for updates.

ops-eng-zen: I'm going to evict preemptible jobs in resv-42 now to free GPUs. executing: ```
rctl evict --pool resv-42 --priority preemptible --reason "incident: free capacity"
```

lia: I see the eviction started. freeing 6 gpus from test/ci jobs. queued_requests dropped from 1243 -> 420 within 5m. autoscaler still getting 429s but reduced pressure.

infra-bot: note: cloud provider reports short API throttle window due to high recent requests; recommended exponential backoff. Next quota window expected in ~4m.

samir: while we wait, let's spin a manual scale command to bypass autoscaler if cloud API accepts it: ```
redwoodctl pool update resv-42 --gpus 40 --force --note "manual bump during incident"
```

lia: ran the manual update at 2623456875. cloud API accepted the request after a brief 429 retry. new pool capacity: 32 -> 40 gpus. verification logs: `PoolUpdate: success, new_capacity=40`

incident-bot: Pool resv-42 capacity increased to 40 gpus. queued_requests now 210 and trending down :white_check_mark:. Autoscaler errors persisted while under 429s but manual bump mitigated immediate customer impact.

oncall_maya: confirmed Greenstone job latency largely recovered — CS seeing jobs completing within expected windows again. thanks everyone.

neha_cs: Greenstone on call acknowledged mitigation and asked for ETA on permanent fix. They requested a follow-up by EOD.

samir: immediate action items: 1) ops to add rate-limiting rule to Greenstone background batch route to cap concurrent batch jobs. 2) infra to open cloud quota increase request (ticket with provider). 3) eng to add autoscaler retry/backoff and 429 handling improvements (PR + test). 4) runbook update to include manual bump commands and eviction steps.

ops-eng-zen: done: added temporary rate limit (concurrency=50) for Greenstone background route. monitoring.

lia: created cloud provider quota ticket #CP-8921 and attached incident logs. ETA depends on provider but flagged urgent.

samir: opened GH issue and assigned autoscaler 429/backoff PR to @lia and @samir: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5423 (WIP). Also filing a post-incident runbook entry.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (customer impact reduced, pool bumped). Retain on-call rota until autoscaler changes merged and quota confirmed.

oncall_maya: assigning follow-ups: postmortem owner = samir, runbook author = lia, quota owner = infra team. Please update the incident channel when PR merges or quota is increased.

neha_cs: I'll keep Greenstone updated and schedule a customer follow-up postmortem call tomorrow.

lia: note for postmortem: consider adding a secondary fallback path to spill traffic to hosted pool automatically when autoscaler returns 429s, and a per-tenant background-batch throttle knob.

samir: adding that to the postmortem checklist. tagging this thread for the incident binder.

ops-eng-zen: closing active mitigation. monitoring for 2h. will escalate if queue growth resumes.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident logged as 2623456789; severity: P1 (enterprise impact). Postmortem required.

oncall_maya: thanks all. final note: everyone please add brief timeline comments to the incident doc (link shared after).
